newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Strong packer demand for fed cattle, higher boxed beef values and strong technical tone.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Strong technically with CME index up and corn futures seen lower.
LIVE HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Cash hogs seen steady to higher and pork complex appears to be bottoming.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Cash upturn may indicate improving demand. Product seasonally shows strength.
